mission.title: Pin where Nepali tea production and harvested area are published
mission.summary: Close the collection gap the retained country pack records for this corridor: find where the two named national bodies publish an annual tea quantity and a tea land figure, and record either the reading itself or the continuing gap in the mission's own terms.

owner.name: Mission owner — unassigned: no human owner has been named for this proposal

mission.beneficiary: Nepali tea producer groups and the municipal or national bodies that would read the resulting briefing; no producer group, cooperative, municipality, exporter or buyer has been selected, consented or contacted as a beneficiary

reviewer.name: Independent reviewer — unassigned: no human reviewer has been named for this proposal

mission.rubric: Every figure the deliverable reports carries its publisher, the document title, the page, table or row it sits in, the fiscal-year basis the publisher uses, the unit, the retrieval date and the checksum of the bytes captured. A figure the publisher labels an estimate, a projection, a preliminary or a revised number is recorded with that label, and a modelled or modelled-from-ILO value is never presented as a national count. Fiscal years are written exactly as the publisher writes them and are never silently converted to calendar years. A requested quantity that is not published is reported as not published, with the pages checked and the dates, and is not replaced by a figure from another publisher, another product or another year. Nothing in the deliverable states a buyer, a price, an export volume, an eligibility or a return.

task.title: Find and pin the annual tea quantity and tea land figure
task.instructions: Work from the two named national bodies outward and record what each one publishes. For each candidate publication, record its title, the page or table, the fiscal-year basis, the unit, the retrieval date and the checksum of the captured bytes. If the quantity or the land figure is not published, record the pages checked, their dates and the statement that it is not published, and stop there rather than substituting a sector indicator. Outputs: the pinned reading or the not-published register; a short note on how the publisher's fiscal year and unit are stated; and a list of the sources named by the country pack that are still unresolved for this question.
task.rights: Each cited page is paraphrased with attribution and pinned to the version read, and each publisher's reuse terms are inspected before anything is reproduced; no page, table, chart, image or logo is reproduced in full. The retained World Bank series are published under CC BY 4.0 with the original provider attributed per indicator, and that attribution is carried with any value taken from them.

question: Which Nepali document states tea production quantity and harvested area for the most recent complete fiscal year, and what value, unit and fiscal-year basis does it state?
limits: The registered series retained for Nepal in catalog/agriculture-statistics.json cover agriculture, forestry and fishing value added, employment in agriculture and arable land share. None of them is tea production or tea harvested area, and the value-added series includes forestry and fishing, so no sector indicator may stand in for the figure. A national figure is an official statement with its own coverage, revision and rounding rules; it is not a measured export, not a buyer signal and not a price. Reading a page establishes only that the text was there on the date recorded. Nothing here establishes buyer demand, supplier capacity, shipment eligibility, price, financing or an economic return, and the mission cannot establish that any producer group wants the briefing. No consenting beneficiary has been selected, so external implementation evidence and any measured outcome are blocked on that dependency; a mission owner's recorded adoption declaration is a declaration, not implementation, and this mission sends no message to any body, producer or publisher.

evidence_gaps: The retained country pack records that no Nepali tea production or harvested-area figure was obtained: the bounded provider previews returned zero rows and no FAOSTAT or ITC figure was extractable (docs/research/country-packs/nepal.md, 2026-10-12, and the pack's evidenceGaps list).

Reading the National Tea and Coffee Development Board and National Statistics Office front pages on 2026-10-14 returned only site headers, so which publication carries a tea quantity or a tea land figure is unresolved. Locating the publication is the mission's first output.

Neither national page exposes a document identifier, edition or version on its front page, so the version a contribution pins will be the captured bytes of the specific publication page, identified by their checksum and the date they were read.

The national statistics publication route was not read in the retained pack either: the pack records that the national agriculture statistical yearbook and the ministry contact page were not downloaded. This mission does not assume the yearbook exists in a usable form.
not_established: No statement about the applicable Indian tea-import directive edition, the consolidated Nepal-India treaty text, any tariff or preference, any producer, grade, packaging or border point. The retained pack records all of those as unverified, and none of them is this mission's question.
No buyer, demand, price, volume, eligibility or return, and no inference from a national production figure to any of them.
No producer or cooperative capacity, seasonality, land tenure or irrigation statement.
No external implementation and no measured outcome: blocked on a consenting beneficiary.
No contact with either national body, and no message sent.

verification.method: Plain HTTPS reads of the two national front pages on 2026-10-14, plus the retained catalog series and the retained country pack already in this repository; the quality module (src/mission-quality.js) was run over this exemplar with the seeded 1015-proposal corpus as the comparison set.
